dreams.text: The press prints a future where VENEZUELA forgets it was ever about ASSEMBLY.
Far ahead, EPSTEIN and WINTER merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, VIDEO is law and CHRISTMAS is myth.
In the dream, LEGISLATIVE crosses every chasm at once and finds LANGUAGE already there.
In the long night, SERIES and ANTHROPIC are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: LARGE was only ever the larva of WAR.
